manuscript_role: Supplementary evidence for R2-M1 and R2-m5; conditional truth that could support a future separately prespecified known-truth SVG benchmark
audience: Genome Biology editor and spatial-transcriptomics reviewers
one_sentence_takeaway: The full finite-basis shared-plus-phenotype-deviation implementation separates the base/reference spatial surface from treatment-coded cell-type deviations, recovers their configured coefficients without an oracle baseline offset, supports target-block tests with explicit null rejection-rate checks, and preserves the original generator when disabled.

model.design: Poisson log link with intercept, three non-reference phenotype main effects, full B(s), and three phenotype-by-B(s) interactions
model.inference: Full-versus-reduced target-block likelihood-ratio test; df equals basis dimension; unadjusted per-gene alpha = 0.05. The base/reference-block test is conditional on deviation blocks.

panels.A: Phenotype labels, type-1-specific direct spatial log-fold truth, and combined-artifact observed expression for count-blind display-selected Gene 46; non-target phenotypes are masked gray in the observed map
panels.B: Separate base/reference-f0 and cell-type-specific-fk coefficient recovery plus target-block power and null rejection rates across 20 seeds
panels.C: One-factor calibration for capture, ambient background, and dropout
panels.D: Consequences for library size, zero fraction, mean-variance association, and latent recovery

panel_c_layout: Equal-sized two-over-one calibration grid: capture and ambient above, dropout centered below.
simulation_scale: 50 x 50 nominal lattice, approximately 1,600 retained cells per seed, four phenotypes, 500 genes
effect_design: For each of four spatial bases, 96 nonzero genes are split equally among the base/reference f0 block and deviations for states 1, 2, and 3 (three genes per signed strength per role); 24 null controls are split as six per role.
linear_effect_direction: Fixed diagonal unit vector (1,1)/sqrt(2); estimated vectors are projected onto this configured direction.
representative_gene: Gene 46: first among nine seed-0 strength-1 cell-type-specific linear candidates under a deterministic count-blind visualization score (weighted-percentile score 77.6; configured 90% truth span = 0.963; Poisson working contrast proxy = 1.71; direct-effect fraction of expected log-count SD = 0.543; high-target/non-target-q95 prominence = 1.94). The contrast and design-information terms are Poisson working ranking proxies, not exact calculations for the dropout-contaminated observation law.
representative_selection_guardrail: Realized counts do not enter selection; the weights were fixed during revision rather than preregistered; selection is explicitly display-only and does not enter coefficient-recovery or likelihood-ratio summaries.

archived_results.fit_convergence: 9,600/9,600 full and reduced fits converged; all fixed-effect designs were full rank
archived_results.test_scope: Unadjusted per-gene alpha 0.05; not an FDR-controlled discovery claim

visual_conventions.observed_counts: Viridis for target-phenotype counts with all non-target phenotypes masked in neutral gray; gray does not denote zero expression
visual_conventions.optional_or_expected_relationships: Dashed identity or nominal-alpha reference lines

assumptions_and_limits: This is controlled validation of SimSpace components, not a cross-method SVG benchmark or fit to a real platform.
The native reference-free generator currently uses library-size factor one.
Coordinate-conditioned effects apply only to the native reference-free generator.
The existing R2-M3 concordance/stability analysis remains separate; a broader cross-method known-truth benchmark would require a future prespecified analysis.
